reasoning: Stability means that solutions starting sufficiently close to the equilibrium remain close for all future time. Convergence is not required; it is an additional requirement for asymptotic stability. Starting exactly at an equilibrium does not characterize stability, since even an unstable equilibrium has a constant solution there.
